about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Bridging business requirements with robust software architectures.
about.paragraph1: I am a final-year Information Technology student at HUTECH (graduating Oct 2026) with a 3.53/4.0 GPA. My technical foundation centers on Backend Development with Java/Spring Boot and C#/.NET Core, while actively expanding into Full-stack applications with React & TypeScript.
about.paragraph2: During my 3-month internship at FPT Information System (FPT IS) within the Banking & Enterprise unit, I self-engineered eProcure Enterprise—a full-stack E-Procurement system adhering to enterprise standards including Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, Keycloak JWT authentication, Camunda BPMN workflow engines, and JasperReports.
about.paragraph3: I actively embrace AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate development velocity, optimize clean architecture patterns, and solve complex technical challenges efficiently.
about.hobbies: When I'm not developing applications, you'll find me playing badminton 🏸, watching sci-fi movies 🎬, gaming 🎮, or creating tech content on my YouTube channel.
